Description:
Add a piece of industrial history to your decor with this lot of two vintage Hemingray glass insulators. Featuring distinct colorsone in rich aqua blue and the other in classic clear each piece is crafted with embossed Hemingray lettering, offering authentic style and historical character. The sturdy dome/cylindrical shapes make them striking display items or unique accents for creative projects. Both insulators are made from glass and retain their original, rugged look, suited for collectors or those appreciating vintage utility pieces. The aqua blue insulator especially stands out as a vibrant collectible, while the clear version brings classic appeal. Display them together as a conversation starter or separate for individual accents either way, their nostalgic charm is sure to enhance your space. Both items appear in good visible condition with no major cracks or chips noted. Perfect for industrial-style displays, utility collectors, or functional upcycling.

It has a dark wood finish with a lighter wood mouthpiece and includes an integrated tripod-style stand at the base for upright display. The pipe shows some minor wear consistent with age, including small surface scratches and slight paint fading. The hand-crafted details highlight its decorative appeal.

278163565.description:
Mixed Gemstone and Mineral Collection
Natural Specimens in Organizer Box
Total Weight: 0.81 lbs
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of natural gemstone and mineral specimens, perfect for beginning collectors or educational purposes. Housed in a durable Bass Pro Shops plastic organizer, the set includes both raw and polished stones. Notable specimens include a large blue-dyed agate slice, a substantial smokey quartz point, and recognizable minerals such as pyrite and amethyst.
Includes over 15 unique geological specimens in a divided storage case
Featured stones: Blue agate, amethyst, smokey quartz, desert rose, and pyrite
Variety of textures including raw crystalline structures and smooth tumbled finishes
Case measures approximately 9 x 6.5 x 1.5 inches with secure latching lid
Condition:
The specimens are in good pre-owned condition, displaying the natural inclusions, fractures, and varied textures typical of geological samples. The blue agate slice is mounted to the underside of the lid. The plastic storage case shows light surface wear and minor scuffing consistent with age and use. All stones are secure within their respective compartments. Total weight is 0.81 lbs as shown on the digital scale.
